info.title: Together Responses API compatibility reference
info.description: Locally maintained, documentation-derived profile of Together Responses. Not an official Together OpenAPI export. Includes Together-documented features with OpenAI-derived wire schemas; nested constraints and event payloads are reference assumptions, not proof of runtime compatibility.

servers.description: Dedicated model inference; use an endpoint identifier as model

x-together-compatibility.scope: POST /v1/responses only. Absence from the modeled subset means unverified unless explicitly listed unsupported. OpenAI nested wire shapes are inherited and require provider testing before strict runtime validation.
x-together-compatibility.web_search: Removed from the request by Together; forcing web_search with tool_choice returns HTTP 400. Not represented as an available tool.
x-together-compatibility.tool_details: Together documents function, custom, shell, local_shell, and apply_patch tools. Detailed custom/shell/patch wire schemas come from OpenAI; advanced options are unverified.
x-together-compatibility.store: Ignored for persistence; even true does not store the response.
x-together-compatibility.models_note: Snapshot of Together documentation on checked_on. Other serverless models may accept requests but can produce malformed output.

reasoning_behavior.GLM-5.3: Reasons at every effort, including none.
reasoning_behavior.GLM-5.2: minimal disables reasoning; low and medium request maximum effort; high requests high effort.

x-together-compatibility.image_and_file_inputs: Images depend on model support; file inputs are unsupported. Image parts with only file_id are silently dropped.
x-together-compatibility.streaming: Together event names are documented; exact payload requirements and additional error/custom-tool events have not been verified.

post.description: Create a stateless response with optional streaming and client-side tool calls. Append prior output and tool results to input for continuation.

value.input: What is the weather in Paris?

200.description: Model response or server-sent event stream.

default.description: Together error. Inspect HTTP status; provider codes may differ from OpenAI.

model.description: Together model identifier, or a dedicated endpoint identifier when using the dedicated inference server.

store.description: Together does not persist responses, including when this flag is true.

CreateResponse.description: Together-documented request subset. Send full history, including previous output items and tool results. Other OpenAI request fields are not confirmed by this profile; additionalProperties allows extensions without asserting support.

Error.description: OpenAI-shaped error envelope; Together error type and code values can differ. Handle errors by HTTP status.

FunctionShellToolParam.description: Client-executed shell tool. Hosted container execution is not represented.

InputImageContent.description: Model-dependent: Together documents image support for GLM-5.3 Flash and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, not GLM-5.3 or GLM-5.2. Supply image_url; Together drops image parts that contain only file_id. Input files are unsupported.

Reasoning.description: Together forwards effort to the model template; behavior depends on the model. No reasoning summaries are generated. These provider values are separate from Switchyard public effort aliases.

encrypted_content.description: When requested through include, Together returns base64-encoded reasoning text here. The content is not encrypted.

content.description: Full reasoning text, expressed as reasoning_text content parts.

ResponseStreamEvent.description: Event vocabulary explicitly listed by Together. Payload structures are inherited from the OpenAI reference and have not been live-tested against Together.

Tool.description: All tool execution happens in the client application. Together does not execute these tools.

ToolChoiceParam.description: Together explicitly documents auto, required, none, and a named function choice.
